T: On your left. Pass the noodles.
D: Steve Rogers uncovers a conspiracy inside S.H.I.E.L.D. and comes face to face with an old friend.
P: Serve the mains when Steve adds another item to his catch-up list.
S: a DC classic after the morning run
Smoked half-pork, half-beef sausages split and grilled, in buns with chilli, mustard and chopped onion.

Toasted mini bagels spread with lemon and dill cream cheese, topped with smoked salmon, red onion, capers and cracked pepper. Split and toast 12 mini bagels until golden. Mix 200g cream cheese with the zest of 1 lemon, 1 tbsp chopped dill and a pinch of salt. Spread thickly on each bagel half. Top with folds of smoked salmon from 200g, a few rings of thinly sliced red onion and 3 or 4 capers. Finish with cracked black pepper and a little more dill.
Sam's safe house pancakes and bacon
Sam letting Steve and Natasha lie low at his house

Small fluffy buttermilk pancakes stacked with melting butter and maple syrup, with crisp streaky bacon on the side. Whisk 300g self-raising flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 2 eggs, 400ml buttermilk and 30g melted butter into a thick batter. Fry 4 tbsp at a time in a buttered pan over medium heat for 2 minutes a side until golden, making about 16. Keep warm in a low oven. Fry 12 bacon rashers until crisp. Stack the pancakes with a knob of butter and pour over maple syrup.
M: Thai food written on Steve's list of things he missed
Chicken thighs stir-fried with garlic, chilli, fish sauce and holy basil, served over jasmine rice with a fried egg.
Helicarrier beef and red wine stew
the S.H.I.E.L.D. helicarriers rising out of the Potomac

Beef chuck braised for hours in red wine and stock with carrots, onions and potatoes until spoon tender, served with crusty bread. Toss 1.2kg diced beef chuck in 2 tbsp plain flour and brown in batches in oil. Soften 2 diced onions and 2 garlic cloves, then add the beef, 250ml red wine, 500ml beef stock, 2 tbsp tomato paste and 2 bay leaves. Cover and simmer gently for 2 hours. Add 3 chopped carrots and 500g potato chunks and cook 1 hour more. Season and serve with crusty bread.
W: Cherry and blueberry pie with a lattice top in red, white and blue, baked at 190C for 45 minutes.
K: Steve visits his own museum exhibit

An old soda fountain drink of homemade cherry syrup, lime and a dash of bitters, topped with fizzing soda over crushed ice. Simmer 300g frozen pitted cherries with 150g caster sugar and 150ml water for 10 minutes, mash well, then strain and cool. For each drink, put 50ml cherry syrup, 15ml lime juice and a dash of bitters in a tall glass of crushed ice. Top with about 200ml soda water and stir once. Garnish with a cherry and a lime wedge.

s.note: a DC classic after the morning run
s.how: Simmer 300g beef mince with 1 onion, 2 tsp chilli powder, 200g crushed tomatoes and 125ml water for 25 minutes. Split 4 smoked half-pork, half-beef sausages and grill 6 minutes. Serve in 4 buns with the chilli, yellow mustard and chopped onion.

Top with folds of smoked salmon from 200g, a few rings of thinly sliced red onion and 3 or 4 capers. Finish with cracked black pepper and a little more dill.

m.note: Thai food written on Steve's list of things he missed
m.how: Stir-fry 600g minced or chopped chicken thighs with crushed garlic and chopped red chilli in a hot wok. Add a splash of fish sauce and a pinch of sugar, then toss through Thai basil. Serve over jasmine rice with a crisp fried egg on top.

w.how: Toss 400g frozen cherries and 200g blueberries with 100g sugar and 3 tbsp cornflour. Line a pie dish with shortcrust, fill and weave a lattice top. Bake at 190C for 45 minutes until bubbling. Serve warm with vanilla ice cream.
